app.name: Coverly ROMs
app.tagline: Find and add the missing cover art in your ROMs

start.dropHint: Or drop a folder or SD card here.

settings.title: Library settings
settings.ignoredDirsHint: One folder name per line. They are skipped at any depth.

library.empty: No ROMs found in this folder.
library.emptyHint: Check that you picked the SD card or its ROMs folder. Warnings: {n}.
library.noMatch: No ROMs match the search and filters.

errors.not-a-folder: This is a file, not a folder: {detail}
errors.unreadable: Coverly ROMs cannot read {detail}. Check its permissions.
errors.no-profile: No known layout was found in {detail}. Pick the SD card root or its ROMs folder.
errors.stale-library: The library was reopened. Try again.
errors.unknown-entry: This ROM is no longer in the library.
errors.art-missing: There is no image for this ROM.
errors.outside-library: This image is outside the library and was not opened.
errors.art-too-large: This image is too large to show.
errors.settings: The settings could not be saved: {detail}
errors.job-running: A fill job is running. Wait for it or cancel it first.
errors.stale-job: That fill job was replaced by a newer one.
errors.network: The art source could not be reached: {detail}
errors.bad-image: This file is not a usable image: {detail}
errors.write-denied: Coverly ROMs cannot write to the library (read-only or no permission): {detail}
errors.name-invalid: This file name is not valid on SD cards: {detail}
errors.volume-gone: The library volume was removed or is no longer reachable: {detail}

drawer.identifyHint: Look this ROM up in the game databases.
drawer.offline: Offline: identified by its file name only.
drawer.laterHint: Changing art arrives in a later version.

fill.title: Fill missing art

strategyHint.rom-region: Prefers the ROM's own region, then the order below.
strategyHint.priority: Prefers the first source, then the order below.
strategyHint.popularity: Prefers the variant that has box, screenshot and title, then source priority.

overwrite.title: Existing art
overwrite.backup: Also replace existing art (with a backup)
overwrite.backupHint: Replaced images are kept in the app's data folder and come back with Undo.

fill.batocera: Batocera and Knulli read art from gamelist.xml, which Coverly ROMs does not update yet: new images may not show until it does.
fill.pausedHint: The dry run paused. Resume it when the connection is back.

pause.rate-limit: Paused: the art server is limiting requests. Wait a few minutes and resume.
pause.offline: Paused: no connection to the art server. Resume when you are back online.
pause.volume: Paused: the SD card is full, read-only or was removed. Fix it and resume.
